Date: Wed, 12 Nov 2025 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SOC 2 artifacts + evidence map for our RFP

Hi Dylan,

We're kicking off final vendor diligence for the Acme Health RFP and need the following to complete our security sign-off:

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- Any bridge letter or attestation covering the period after the report if applicable
- A control-to-evidence index (mapping controls to artifacts/evidence) that aligns to a SIG/CAIQ mapping — we use this to speed review

One quick call could also be useful if there are gaps you expect in coverage. Our procurement deadline is 11/25; can you confirm you can deliver by then?

Thanks,
Sarah White
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health

Date: Thu, 13 Nov 2025 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 artifacts + evidence map for our RFP

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and the timeline. We're on it.

Summary / immediate plan:
- Attaching our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (note: audit period ended 2024-10-31).
- Including the bridge letter that covers interim controls through 2025-04-30.
- Sharing an evidence index draft (internal mapping) — we'll finalize to the SIG rows you care about.

Quick caveat on dates: our last full Type II covers 11/01/2023–10/31/2024. There is a known gap between 11/01/2024 and the bridge coverage start (11/15/2024) for a small set of control snapshots; Rishi is looping in compliance to confirm exact control-level continuity and provide an addendum where possible.

Attachments:
- SOC2_TypeII_Report_2024-10.pdf (PDF, 6.2MB)
- Bridge_Letter_2025-04.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
- Evidence_Index_Draft.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)

Would you like a short 20-minute call next week (Mon/Tue) to walk the index? If so, what timezone works best for you?

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Dylan / Grace — quick internal note before we send the finalized package to Acme:

1) Audit coverage dates: Confirmed with auditor (ClearBridge) — Type II report audit period is 2023-11-01 through 2024-10-31. Bridge letter provides attestations for controls through 2025-04-30. We have a documented control snapshot gap limited to two change windows (11/05/2024 and 02/14/2025) where evidence is operationally different; both are documented in the evidence index.

2) Evidence index: I've updated the spreadsheet to include SIG/CAIQ column mappings and direct artifact pointers (S3 paths + Drive links). See attached Evidence_Index_v2.xlsx. This version flags items that are partial ("requires attestation") so procurement can triage.

3) Recommended external wording: please use the following phrasing when you send the package to Acme — it reduces follow-ups.

"Attached: Redwood Inference SOC 2 Type II (audit period 2023-11-01 — 2024-10-31), Bridge Letter (covers controls through 2025-04-30), and an Evidence Index mapped to SIG/CAIQ. Two control snapshots are flagged as requiring attestation in the Evidence Index — compliance can attest to compensating controls on request."

I attached Evidence_Index_v2.xlsx (48KB). I'll also contact ClearBridge (audit@clearbridge.com) to ask if they can expedite a short addendum that lists the two change windows and control mitigations — I'll report back.

-Rishi

Dylan — thanks for the quick turnaround and for looping compliance in. Received the files and the updated evidence index. A few follow-ups before our review team completes scoring: 

- Can you confirm the exact coverage window included in the Bridge Letter (start/end dates) and whether it is signed by your external auditor?
- For the two flagged control snapshots, will compliance provide a written attestation we can include in the procurement record, or do you need our team to accept compensating controls language?
- If ClearBridge can provide a short addendum/attestation, please send that directly to audit@acmehealth.com and cc me.

If you can confirm the above by 11/20 we should be able to proceed to the final approval step on our side. Otherwise our procurement team may need to push selection by a week.

Also: we prefer signed artifacts where possible (PDFs with signatures) — if the bridge letter or attestation from ClearBridge can be signed, that will speed our legal review.

Thanks,
